name: 2 Peter
note_text: 2 Peter 3:10 retains “burned up” in the original 1901 main text, while its printed margin reports “The most ancient manuscripts read discovered.” This must remain separate manuscript apparatus.

other_apparatus.note: The original 1901 margin gives the proper-name alternative “Or, Symeon. See Acts 15.14” and other translation alternatives. This does not change the printed main text.

The original printed margin gives “Gr. Tartarus” and alternatives concerning the confinement of sinful angels; a separate note mentions some ancient authorities reading “chains.” These remain original apparatus.
The original 1901 main text reads “burned up”; its printed footnote states “The most ancient manuscripts read discovered.” No later manuscript judgment is imported into the verse text.
The original margin notes Greek wording of the closing phrase as “unto the day of eternity.” This is a translation note, not a replacement for the main text.
